title: MGPU concurrency fingerprint synthesis for TP/PP inference under KV-warmup
creator: Mateo Ruiz
description: Goal: Build a reproducible 'concurrency fingerprint' benchmark that captures tokens/sec and p95 latency behavior across multi-GPU TP/PP topologies with realistic KV-cache warmup and mixed sequence-length traffic. This ticket scopes the harness design, noise reduction, baseline collection, and automated regression detection rules for CI/Grafana alerts.
acceptance_criteria: New benchmark harness runs end-to-end across supported TP/PP meshes (1xTPxPP up to 8xTPxPP) and emits tokens/sec and p95 latency series to the perf metrics pipeline
Benchmark supports three workload profiles: short (seqlen 64), mixed (seqlen distribution 16/64/512), and long (seqlen 2048)
KV-cache warmup scenarios: cold (no prefix), warm (100-token prefix), and hot (cached prefix) implemented and results are annotated
Automated regression detector flags +/-10% tokens/sec or +20% p95 deviations versus a 7-day rolling baseline with false-positive suppression (EWMA + MAD) and creates a GitHub issue template
Documentation + Confluence runbook for running, interpreting, and adding new topologies/datasets
test_steps: Provision test fleet using dedicated CI pool: 4xA100 nodes and a heterogeneous 2xA100+2xH100 mix
Deploy runtime build (runtime-1.20-canary) with instrumentation turned on
Run sequence of 3 workload profiles, each with concurrency sweep 1..256 concurrently issued requests; capture tokens/sec, p95, p50, qps, and GPU utilization
Repeat each config 5 times and store raw traces in s3://redwood-perf/ENG-201517/
Run regression-detector job that compares latest run to baseline window and emits result into perf-alerts channel
metrics_and_thresholds: latency: p95_latency_ms (target: < 200ms for short, < 600ms for mixed under 64 conc.)
stability: run-to-run CV (coeff of variation) < 7% for tokens/sec under steady-state
regression-detector: EWMA alpha=0.2, MAD-window=21 days, triggering condition: tokens_per_sec drop >=10% sustained for 3 windows OR p95 increase >=20% in one window
infrastructure: Node types: a100-80gb, h100-80gb, vcpus for driver nodes (16 vCPU)
Storage: s3 perf-bench archive + ephemeral NVMe for local trace aggregation
notes_and_tradeoffs: We avoid full production traffic replay due to cost; use mixed synthetic distributions tuned to match observed token/prefix ratios from console-telemetry
Decision: prefer EWMA+MAD detector vs simple z-score to reduce sensitivity to non-Gaussian tails seen in p95 series
Tradeoff: 5 repeats per-config increases CI runtime by ~4x but reduces false-positive rate for regression detection; acceptable for P0
Plan to add a lightweight canary variant later that runs on every runtime PR with lower repeats
